vocabulary.precedence: A #717 rescue is path=rescue only when both of its gates are open without PassthroughOnError: C# preservation (lossless fidelity -> enabledBy=lossless-fidelity, or interop mode) and, for a round-trip failure, RescueUnusableMembers (enabledBy=rescueUnusableMembers). Otherwise it is path=passthrough, enabledBy=passthroughOnError. So with both options on, lossless reports rescue and lossy standard mode reports passthrough.

decisions.detail: calor convert sets RescueUnusableMembers=true; MCP calor_convert and the library keep false (the library contract keeps the native AST on failure). The governing 0.25 scope forbids making APIs more permissive to force parity. Every report now carries rescueUnusableMembers and passthroughOnError, and a refusal says which were off. Documented on website/content/cli/mcp.mdx.

The visitor gives a global-namespace type the caller's ModuleName as its namespace identity; the rescue's source map did not, so TryTakeSource never matched. CollectTopLevelTypeSources now uses the same fallback. Affected MCP calor_convert moduleName and inputPath (which derives a module name), calor_batch moduleNameOverride, and library ModuleName.

Project migration converts with ValidateRoundTripCSharp=false and validates the generated C# once for the project, so the per-file round-trip rescue never runs, with or without passthroughOnError. Such a file fails, and lossless project migration then writes nothing (every file reports outcome=refused with its conversion counts). Changing this would change migrate defaults; left for a scoped follow-up.

Under lossy fidelity in standard mode, ShouldPreserveCSharp is true only because of PassthroughOnError. The context now records when that getter opened the gate only through PassthroughOnError, and the next interop loss is labelled path=passthrough, trigger=unsupported-construct, enabledBy=passthroughOnError. Catch filters test MemberInteropEscalationException before the gate, so an escalation (preserved in every mode) never marks passthrough. Rescue precedence also accounts for the preservation gate: with both options on, lossless reports rescue, lossy reports passthrough.

src/Calor.Sdk contains only MSBuild Sdk.props/Sdk.targets and has no conversion entry point; Calor.Tasks and Calor.LanguageServer do not call the converter. The SDK cells are measured on the public CSharpToCalorConverter library.
